evidence: Adds an end-to-end functional test exercising wallet PSBT signing and spending with MuSig2 and Miniscript descriptors.
rationale: Adds useful integration test coverage and documentation for complex decaying multisig wallet workflows across watch-only and single-key signers. The test validates end-to-end PSBT handling for advanced descriptors that previously lacked dedicated test coverage, providing solid regression protection for an advanced feature without addressing an active bug.
